_comment: Label taxonomy for the Linear team backing this repo. UUIDs are blank in the public repo — create the labels in your own workspace and fill in the ids.

area.pipeline.reason: Legacy area enum value 'pipeline' collided with Linear label group 'pipeline'. Import script maps area=pipeline → Linear label 'pipeline-system' (under parent 'area').

pipeline.pipeline-review.reason: Legacy pipelines enum value 'pipeline-review' collided with source.pipeline-review. Import script maps pipelines=[pipeline-review] → Linear label 'pipeline-review-sweep' (under parent 'pipeline').

category.bug.reason: Workspace-level 'Bug' label pre-existed and could not be deleted via MCP. Import maps category=bug → existing 'Bug' label (non-grouped). No current YAML items use category=bug; relevant for future NEW findings.
